/** جلب مدارس حسب الإمارة والنوع */
function getSchoolsByEmirateAndType(emirate, type) {
  return SCHOOLS_DB.filter(s =>
    (!emirate || s.emirate === emirate || s.region === emirate) &&
    (!type    || s.type === type)
  );
}

/** بحث بالنص أو الكود الداخلي أو الرقم الرسمي */
function searchSchools(query) {
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const numQ = parseInt(query.trim(), 10);
  return SCHOOLS_DB.filter(s =>
    s.code.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
    s.name_ar.includes(query) ||
    s.name_en.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
    s.area.includes(query) ||
    (!isNaN(numQ) && s.official_id === numQ)
  );
}

/** جلب مدرسة بكودها الداخلي */
function getSchoolByCode(code) {
  return SCHOOLS_DB.find(s => s.code === code) || null;
}

/**
 * جلب مدرسة برقمها الرسمي (eSIS / MOE / ADEK / KHDA)
 * @param {number|string} id — الرقم الرسمي
 * @returns {object|null}
 */
function getSchoolByOfficialId(id) {
  const numId = parseInt(id, 10);
  if (isNaN(numId)) return null;
  return SCHOOLS_DB.find(s => s.official_id === numId) || null;
}

/**
 * التحقق من صحة الرقم الرسمي (3–5 أرقام فقط)
 * @param {string|number} id
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
function isValidOfficialId(id) {
  const s = String(id).trim();
  return /^\d{3,5}$/.test(s);
}

/** إحصائيات */
const SCHOOLS_STATS = {
  total:       SCHOOLS_DB.length,
  government:  SCHOOLS_DB.filter(s => s.type === 'حكومية').length,
  private:     SCHOOLS_DB.filter(s => s.type === 'خاصة').length,
  intl:        SCHOOLS_DB.filter(s => s.type === 'دولية').length,
  emirates:    [...new Set(SCHOOLS_DB.map(s => s.emirate))].length,
};

console.log(`📚 Schools DB loaded: ${SCHOOLS_STATS.total} schools | Gov: ${SCHOOLS_STATS.government} | Private: ${SCHOOLS_STATS.private} | Intl: ${SCHOOLS_STATS.intl}`);

    /* ☀️ فاتح — بلا نقش */
    light:     null,
    /* 🚨 طوارئ — له نقشه الخاص في CSS الصفحة */

    remote:    null,
  };

  let currentTheme = 'default';

  // ── تطبيق الثيم ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  function apply(id){
    const theme = THEMES.find(t => t.id === id) || THEMES[0];
    const root = document.documentElement;
    Object.entries(theme.vars).forEach(([k, v]) => root.style.setProperty(k, v));

    // class على body للتمييز بين الليلي والفاتح
    document.body.classList.remove('theme-dark','theme-light','theme-contextual');
    document.body.classList.add('theme-' + theme.category);
    document.body.dataset.theme = id;

    currentTheme = id;
    try { sessionStorage.setItem('eduos_theme', id); } catch(e){}

    // تحديث زر الثيم
    const btn = document.getElementById('theme-toggle-btn');
    if(btn) btn.textContent = theme.icon;

    // تحديث الـ active في picker إن كان مفتوحاً
    document.querySelectorAll('.edu-theme-card').forEach(c => {
      const active = c.dataset.theme === id;
      c.style.borderColor = active ? 'var(--indigo)' : 'var(--border)';
      c.style.background  = active ? 'var(--glow-indigo)' : 'var(--surface2)';
      const badge = c.querySelector('.edu-theme-active');
      if(badge) badge.style.display = active ? 'block' : 'none';
    });

  }

  // ── واجهة اختيار الثيم ───────────────────────────────────────
  function openPicker(){
    let overlay = document.getElementById('edu-theme-picker');
    if(overlay){ overlay.remove(); return; }

    overlay = document.createElement('div');
    overlay.id = 'edu-theme-picker';
    overlay.style.cssText = `
      position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:99998;
      background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6); backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
      display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
      font-family:'Tajawal',sans-serif; direction:rtl; padding:16px;
    `;

    // بناء الأقسام
    const sectionsHTML = Object.entries(CATEGORIES).map(([catId, cat]) => {
      if(!cat.themes.length) return '';
      const cards = cat.themes.map(t => `
        <div class="edu-theme-card" data-theme="${t.id}"
          onclick="EduTheme.apply('${t.id}')"
          style="
            background:${t.id===currentTheme?'var(--glow-indigo)':'var(--surface2)'};
            border:2px solid ${t.id===currentTheme?'var(--indigo)':'var(--border)'};
            border-radius:14px; padding:14px 10px; cursor:pointer;
            text-align:center; transition:all .25s;
          "
          onmouseover="if(this.dataset.theme!=='${currentTheme}') this.style.borderColor='var(--indigo2)'"
          onmouseout="if(this.dataset.theme!=='${currentTheme}') this.style.borderColor='var(--border)'"
        >
          <div style="font-size:26px;margin-bottom:6px">${t.icon}</div>
          <div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);line-height:1.3">${t.name}</div>
          <div class="edu-theme-active" style="display:${t.id===currentTheme?'block':'none'};font-size:10px;color:var(--indigo2);margin-top:5px;font-weight:600">✓ نشط</div>
        </div>
      `).join('');
      return `
        <div style="margin-bottom:18px">
          <div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:10px;padding-right:2px">${cat.label}</div>
          <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(110px,1fr));gap:8px">${cards}</div>
        </div>
      `;
    }).join('');

    overlay.innerHTML = `
      <div style="
        background:var(--surface);
        border:1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius:20px; padding:24px;
        width:100%; max-width:560px;
        max-height:88vh; overflow-y:auto;
        box-shadow:0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
      ">
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:20px">
          <div style="font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text)">🎨 اختاري الثيم</div>
          <button onclick="document.getElementById('edu-theme-picker').remove()"
            style="
              width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;
              background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);
              color:var(--text2);font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;
              display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
              transition:all .2s; font-family:'Tajawal',sans-serif;
            "
            onmouseover="this.style.background='#ef4444';this.style.color='#fff'"
            onmouseout="this.style.background='var(--surface2)';this.style.color='var(--text2)'">✕</button>
        </div>
        ${sectionsHTML}
        <div style="
          padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);
          font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);text-align:center;
        ">
          الثيم يُطبَّق فوراً ويُحفظ للجلسة الحالية فقط
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

    overlay.addEventListener('click', e => { if(e.target === overlay) overlay.remove(); });
    document.body.appendChild(overlay);
  }

  // ── حقن platform-design-system.css تلقائياً ────────────────
  function injectDesignSystem(){
    const dsId = 'eduos-design-system-css';
    if(document.getElementById(dsId)) return; // لا تُحقن مرتين
    // الرابط النسبي: platform-theme.js → ../platform-design-system.css
    const link = document.createElement('link');
    link.id = dsId;
    link.rel = 'stylesheet';
    // نحدد المسار بناءً على موقع الـ script الحالي
    const scripts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('script[src]'));
    const themeScript = scripts.find(s => s.src && s.src.includes('platform-theme'));
    let base = '../'; // افتراضي: الصفحة في apps/eduos-xxx/
    if(themeScript){
      const scriptPath = new URL(themeScript.src);
      base = scriptPath.href.replace('platform-theme.js', '');
    }
    link.href = base + 'platform-design-system.css';
    document.head.appendChild(link);
  }

  // ── تهيئة عند التحميل ───────────────────────────────────────
  function init(){
    injectDesignSystem();
    let saved = 'default';
    try { saved = sessionStorage.getItem('eduos_theme') || 'default'; } catch(e){}
    apply(saved);
  }

  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }

  return { apply, openPicker, THEMES, CATEGORIES };

})();

يُبلِّغ فقط · Inform
يعرض المعلومات والتحليلات — لا يتصرف ولا يقترح تغييراً. مستوى القراءة الصافية.

يقترح + يستأذن · Suggest
يقترح الخطوة التالية ويطلب موافقة صريحة قبل أي تنفيذ. لكل قرار يمس إنساناً.
موافقة إلزامية

يُنفِّذ + يتعلم · Execute
يُنفِّذ المهمة ثم يُبلِّغ — ويتعلم من ردود الفعل لتحسين أدائه في المرة القادمة.
تنفيذ + تعلم
D
مستقل كاملاً · Autonomous
يعمل باستقلالية تامة للمهام التقنية فقط — لا يُطبَّق على أي قرار يمس إنساناً.

جهة تنظيمية لإدارة الرسوم

البنية مصمَّمة للتوسع: Country → Education System → School. يعمل في الإمارات، المملكة، الكويت، وأي نظام تعليمي — بلا تعديل جوهري.

كل قرار في المنصة له مستوى استقلالية محدد — الذكاء الاصطناعي لا يتصرف منفرداً في أي قرار يمس إنساناً. الشفافية والمسؤولية مدمجتان في كل وظيفة.

A
يُبلِّغ فقط
يعرض المعلومة ويترك القرار للإنسان كلياً
B
يقترح ويستأذن
يقترح إجراءً ولا ينفذه إلا بعد موافقة صريحة
C
ينفذ ويُبلِّغ
ينفذ ويُعلم المسؤول/ة ويتعلم من النتيجة
D
مستقل تقنياً
للمهام التقنية البحتة فقط — لا يمس قرارات بشرية أبداً

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0"/>
<title>Teacher OS — بوابة الجود الذكية</title>
<!-- EduOS Teacher Portal v2.1 -->
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Tajawal:wght@400;500;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<script src="../platform-config.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
<script src="../platform-auth-guard.js"></script>
<script src="../platform-shield.js" defer></script>
<script src="../platform-week.js" defer></script>
<script src="../platform-lang.js" defer></script>
<script src="../platform-motd.js" defer></script>
<script src="../platform-agent-brain.js" defer></script>
<script src="../platform-student-state.js" defer></script>
<script src="../platform-live-clock.js" defer></script>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
:root{
  --bg:#F2F4F7;--surface:#FFFFFF;--surface2:#F8FAFB;--surface3:#EEF2FF;
  --brand:#6C3DD6;--brand2:#22D3EE;--brand-lt:rgba(108,61,214,0.08);
  --emerald:#059669;--emerald-lt:rgba(5,150,105,0.08);
  --rose:#E11D48;--rose-lt:rgba(225,29,72,0.08);
  --amber:#D97706;--amber-lt:rgba(217,119,6,0.08);
  --sky:#0284C7;--sky-lt:rgba(2,132,199,0.08);
  --text:#1E293B;--text2:#475569;--text3:#94A3B8;
  --border:#E2E8F0;
  --shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06),0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
}
body{font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-size:18px;min-height:100vh;overflow:hidden}

/* ── APP SHELL ── */
.app-shell{display:flex;height:100vh;overflow:hidden}

/* ── SIDEBAR ── */
.sidebar{width:220px;min-width:220px;background:var(--surface);border-left:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;flex-direction:column;z-index:10;box-shadow:-2px 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)}
.sidebar-brand{padding:18px 16px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.brand-logo{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand),var(--brand2));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;color:#fff;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:8px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(108,61,214,0.3)}
.brand-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:900;color:var(--brand);line-height:1.2}
.brand-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:2px}
.sidebar-nav{flex:1;padding:10px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;overflow-y:auto}
.snav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:11px 12px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid transparent;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;text-align:right;direction:rtl;transition:all .15s;width:100%}
.snav:hover{background:var(--brand-lt)}
.snav.active{background:var(--brand-lt);border-color:rgba(108,61,214,0.2)}
.snav.active .snav-label{color:var(--brand)}
.snav-icon{font-size:20px;min-width:24px;text-align:center}
.snav-text{flex:1}
.snav-label{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);display:block;line-height:1.2}
.snav-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);display:block;margin-top:1px}
.snav-badge{background:var(--rose);color:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:1px 7px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;min-width:20px;text-align:center}
.sidebar-footer{padding:10px 8px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
.logout-btn{width:100%;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--rose-lt);border:1px solid rgba(225,29,72,0.15);color:var(--rose);font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.logout-btn:hover{background:var(--rose);color:#fff}

/* ── MAIN AREA ── */
.main-area{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}

/* ── TOP BAR ── */
.top-bar{background:var(--surface);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:0 24px;height:60px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-shrink:0}
.top-bar-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.top-bar-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.context-pill{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;padding:5px 14px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-weight:600}
.context-pill .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--emerald)}
.user-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:24px;padding:4px 14px 4px 4px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.user-chip:hover{border-color:var(--brand)}
.user-avatar{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand),var(--brand2));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:#fff}
.user-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text)}
.user-role{font-size:11px;color:var(--brand)}
.notif-btn{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;position:relative;transition:all .2s}
.notif-btn:hover{border-color:var(--brand);background:var(--brand-lt)}
.notif-dot{display:none;position:absolute;top:5px;right:5px;width:9px;height:9px;background:var(--rose);border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--surface)}
.lang-toggle{padding:6px 14px;border-radius:20px;border:1.5px solid #6C3DD6;background:transparent;font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#6C3DD6;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.lang-toggle:hover{border-color:var(--brand);color:var(--brand)}

/* ── PANELS AREA ── */
.panels-area{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:24px}
.tab-panel{display:none}
.tab-panel.active{display:block}

/* ── GREETING CARD ── */
.greeting-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand) 0%,var(--brand2) 100%);border-radius:16px;padding:22px 28px;color:#fff;margin-bottom:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(108,61,214,0.25)}
.greeting-text h2{font-size:21px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:4px}
.greeting-text p{font-size:14px;opacity:.85}
.greeting-meta{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.meta-pill{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.18);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 16px;text-align:center;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.meta-pill .val{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;line-height:1}
.meta-pill .lbl{font-size:11px;opacity:.8;margin-top:2px}

/* ── KPI ROW ── */
.kpi-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-bottom:20px}
.kpi-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:20px 22px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:all .2s;cursor:default}
.kpi-card:hover{border-color:var(--brand);transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(108,61,214,0.1)}
.kpi-icon{font-size:32px;min-width:44px;text-align:center}
.kpi-val{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;color:var(--text);line-height:1}
.kpi-label{font-size:14px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:4px}
.kpi-delta{font-size:13px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:2px}

/* ── PERIOD NOW CARD ── */
.period-now-card{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--emerald),#10B981);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 24px;color:#fff;margin-bottom:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(5,150,105,0.3);animation:pulse-grn 2s infinite}
@keyframes pulse-grn{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(5,150,105,0.3)}50%{box-shadow:0 4px 28px rgba(5,150,105,0.5)}}
.period-now-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:900}
.period-now-sub{font-size:14px;opacity:.85;margin-top:4px}
.period-now-timer{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;text-align:center}
.period-now-timer-lbl{font-size:11px;opacity:.75;text-align:center;margin-top:2px}
.btn-start-session{padding:12px 24px;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:var(--emerald);font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:900;border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap}
.btn-start-session:hover{background:#F0FFF4;transform:scale(1.02)}

/* ── SCHEDULE ── */
.schedule-section{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.schedule-header{padding:16px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:var(--surface2)}
.schedule-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:900;color:var(--text)}
.sched-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:16px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);transition:background .15s}
.sched-item:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.sched-item:hover{background:var(--surface2)}
.sched-item.current{background:rgba(5,150,105,0.05);border-right:4px solid var(--emerald)}
.sched-item.done{opacity:.55}
.sched-time{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text2);min-width:55px;text-align:center}
.sched-bar{width:4px;height:44px;border-radius:4px;flex-shrink:0}
.sched-bar.brand{background:var(--brand)}.sched-bar.emerald{background:var(--emerald)}.sched-bar.amber{background:var(--amber)}.sched-bar.sky{background:var(--sky)}
.sched-info{flex:1}
.sched-subject{font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text)}
.sched-class{font-size:14px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:3px}
.sched-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}

/* ── BUTTONS ── */
.btn-sm{padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border:none;transition:all .15s;white-space:nowrap}
.btn-primary{background:var(--brand);color:#fff}.btn-primary:hover{background:#5a32b8}
.btn-emerald{background:var(--emerald);color:#fff}.btn-emerald:hover{background:#047857}
.btn-ghost{background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text2)}.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--brand);color:var(--brand)}
.btn-brand{padding:9px 18px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--brand);color:#fff;border:none;font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.btn-brand:hover{background:#5a32b8}

/* ── VIEW TOGGLE (today/week) ── */
.view-toggle{display:flex;gap:4px;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:4px}
.vtb{padding:6px 14px;border-radius:7px;border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--text2);font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.vtb.active{background:var(--surface);color:var(--brand);box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)}
.today-inner{display:none}.today-inner.active{display:block}

/* ── BRAIN BAR ── */
.brain-bar{background:var(--surface);border:2px solid rgba(108,61,214,0.2);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 20px;display:none;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.brain-icon{font-size:28px}
.brain-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:var(--brand)}
.brain-msg{font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:3px;line-height:1.5}
.brain-badge{background:var(--brand-lt);color:var(--brand);border-radius:20px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.brain-action{padding:8px 16px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--brand);color:#fff;border:none;font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.brain-action:hover{background:#5a32b8}

/* ── EMPTY ── */
.empty{text-align:center;padding:48px 24px;color:var(--text3)}
.empty .icon{font-size:48px;margin-bottom:12px}
.empty p{font-size:16px}

/* ── VARK / ALERT ── */
.vark-banner{display:none;background:var(--amber-lt);border:2px solid var(--amber);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 20px;margin-bottom:16px;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--amber)}
.alert-banner{padding:12px 18px;border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:14px}
.alert-banner.danger{background:var(--rose-lt);color:var(--rose);border:1px solid rgba(225,29,72,0.2)}
.alert-banner.info{background:var(--brand-lt);color:var(--brand);border:1px solid rgba(108,61,214,0.2)}

/* ── TABLE ── */
.table-wrapper{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.table-toolbar{padding:16px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;background:var(--surface2)}
.search-input,.filter-select{padding:9px 14px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:15px;color:var(--text);background:var(--surface);outline:none}
.search-input{flex:1;min-width:160px}.search-input:focus,.filter-select:focus{border-color:var(--brand)}
.filter-select{cursor:pointer}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
th{padding:12px 16px;text-align:right;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text2);background:var(--surface2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
td{padding:13px 16px;font-size:15px;color:var(--text);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
tr:hover td{background:var(--surface2)}
.grade-chip{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800}
.grade-a{background:rgba(5,150,105,0.1);color:var(--emerald)}.grade-b{background:rgba(2,132,199,0.1);color:var(--sky)}.grade-c{background:rgba(217,119,6,0.1);color:var(--amber)}.grade-d{background:rgba(225,29,72,0.1);color:var(--rose)}.grade-x{background:var(--surface2);color:var(--text3)}
.flag-chip{background:var(--rose-lt);color:var(--rose);border-radius:20px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.sb1-bar{display:inline-block;width:60px;height:6px;background:var(--border);border-radius:3px;vertical-align:middle;margin-left:4px}
.sb1-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--brand),var(--brand2));border-radius:3px}

/* ── WEEK GRID ── */
.week-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:60px repeat(5,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--border)}
.wg-header{background:var(--surface2);padding:10px 8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;text-align:center;color:var(--text)}
.wg-period-label{background:var(--surface);padding:10px 6px;text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--text2)}
.wg-cell{background:var(--surface);padding:10px 8px;font-size:12px}
.wg-cell.today-col{background:rgba(108,61,214,0.03)}.wg-cell.current-period{background:rgba(5,150,105,0.1)}
.wg-subject{font-weight:700;color:var(--text);font-size:13px}.wg-class{color:var(--text2);font-size:11px;margin-top:2px}.wg-empty{color:var(--text3);text-align:center}

/* ── SUB NAV ── */
.sub-nav{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sub-nav-btn{padding:10px 18px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface);color:var(--text2);font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.sub-nav-btn:hover{border-color:var(--brand);color:var(--brand)}
.sub-nav-btn.active{background:var(--brand);color:#fff;border-color:var(--brand)}
.sub-panel{display:none}.sub-panel.active{display:block}

/* ── MESSAGES ── */
.msg-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:260px 1fr;gap:16px;height:520px}
.msg-list{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;overflow-y:auto}
.msg-list-item{padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;position:relative}
.msg-list-item:hover{background:var(--surface2)}
.msg-list-item.active{background:var(--brand-lt);border-right:3px solid var(--brand)}
.msg-sender{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text)}
.msg-preview{font-size:13px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:4px}
.msg-time{font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);float:left;direction:ltr}
.msg-unread-dot{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;background:var(--brand);border-radius:50%;margin-right:6px}
.msg-chat{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.msg-chat-header{padding:14px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text);background:var(--surface2);border-radius:14px 14px 0 0}
.msg-chat-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.msg-bubble{max-width:65%;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:14px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5}
.msg-bubble.mine{background:var(--brand);color:#fff;align-self:flex-start;border-radius:14px 14px 4px 14px}
.msg-bubble.theirs{background:var(--surface2);color:var(--text);align-self:flex-end;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px 14px 14px 4px}
.msg-bubble-time{font-size:11px;opacity:.65;margin-top:4px}
.msg-chat-footer{padding:12px 16px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;gap:10px}
.msg-input{flex:1;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:15px;color:var(--text);background:var(--surface);outline:none}
.msg-input:focus{border-color:var(--brand)}
.msg-search{width:100%;padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;border-top:none;border-right:none;border-left:none;outline:none;color:var(--text)}

/* ── TIMELINE ── */
.timeline{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.timeline-item{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start}
.timeline-dot{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0}
.timeline-dot.past{background:var(--text3)}.timeline-dot.today{background:var(--emerald)}.timeline-dot.upcoming{background:var(--brand)}
.timeline-body{flex:1;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 18px}
.timeline-body.today{border-color:var(--emerald);background:rgba(5,150,105,0.04)}
.timeline-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text)}
.timeline-meta{font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:4px}
.timeline-badge{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-top:8px}
.t-past{background:var(--surface2);color:var(--text3)}.t-today{background:rgba(5,150,105,0.1);color:var(--emerald)}.t-upcoming{background:var(--brand-lt);color:var(--brand)}

/* ── PD ── */
.pd-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:20px}
.pd-stat{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:16px;text-align:center}
.pd-stat .val{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;color:var(--brand)}.pd-stat .lbl{font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:4px}
.pd-events{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.pd-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:16px 20px;display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;transition:all .15s}
.pd-card:hover{border-color:var(--brand)}
.pd-date-box{background:var(--brand);color:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px;text-align:center;min-width:52px;flex-shrink:0}
.pd-date-box .day{font-size:22px;font-weight:900;line-height:1}.pd-date-box .month{font-size:11px;opacity:.8}
.pd-body{flex:1}.pd-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text)}.pd-org{font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:3px}
.pd-tag{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-top:8px;margin-left:6px}
.pd-tag.moe{background:rgba(5,150,105,0.1);color:var(--emerald)}.pd-tag.online{background:var(--sky-lt);color:var(--sky)}.pd-tag.school{background:var(--brand-lt);color:var(--brand)}

/* ── AI ── */
.suggestion-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:18px 20px;display:flex;gap:14px;margin-bottom:12px}
.suggestion-icon{font-size:28px}.suggestion-body{flex:1}
.suggestion-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text)}
.suggestion-text{font-size:14px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:6px;line-height:1.5}
.suggestion-level{display:inline-block;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;margin-top:8px}
.level-A{background:rgba(5,150,105,0.1);color:var(--emerald)}.level-B{background:var(--brand-lt);color:var(--brand)}.level-C{background:var(--amber-lt);color:var(--amber)}.level-D{background:var(--rose-lt);color:var(--rose)}
.suggestion-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.btn-approve{padding:8px 16px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--emerald);color:#fff;border:none;font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.btn-reject{padding:8px 16px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--rose-lt);color:var(--rose);border:1px solid rgba(225,29,72,0.2);font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.ai-input-row{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
.ai-input{flex:1;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:15px;outline:none}
.ai-input:focus{border-color:var(--brand)}
.ai-send-btn{padding:12px 20px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--brand);color:#fff;border:none;font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.ai-send-btn:hover{background:#5a32b8}

/* ── TRACK ── */
.track-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.track-nav-label{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text2);flex:1;text-align:center}
.track-nav-btn{padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text2)}
.track-nav-btn:hover{border-color:var(--brand);color:var(--brand)}
.track-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:20px 24px;margin-bottom:14px;transition:all .2s}
.track-card.approved{border-color:var(--emerald)}.track-card.locked{opacity:.7}
.track-card-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.track-week-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text)}
.track-status-badge{padding:4px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.ts-approved{background:rgba(5,150,105,0.1);color:var(--emerald)}.ts-locked{background:var(--surface2);color:var(--text3)}.ts-pending{background:var(--amber-lt);color:var(--amber)}.ts-draft{background:var(--brand-lt);color:var(--brand)}
.track-item-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.track-item-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.track-item-num{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--brand-lt);color:var(--brand);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
.track-item-text{flex:1;font-size:15px;color:var(--text)}.track-item-done{text-decoration:line-through;color:var(--text3)}
.track-approve-btn{padding:10px 20px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--emerald);color:#fff;border:none;font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}

/* ── REPORTS ── */
.report-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:20px}
.report-btn-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:24px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
.report-btn-card:hover{border-color:var(--brand);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(108,61,214,0.1)}
.report-btn-card .r-icon{font-size:36px;margin-bottom:10px}
.report-btn-card .r-label{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text)}
.report-btn-card .r-sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:4px}

/* ── SESSION ── */
.session-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:24px;margin-bottom:16px}
.session-card-title{font-size:17px;font-weight:900;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.session-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}

/* ── TOAST ── */
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(80px);background:var(--text);color:#fff;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:12px;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;z-index:9999;opacity:0;transition:all .3s;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)}
.toast.show{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);opacity:1}

/* ── SCROLLBAR ── */
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px;height:5px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border);border-radius:6px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover{background:var(--text3)}

/* ── SECTION TITLE ── */
.sec-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:900;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--border)}
.sec-title .badge{background:var(--brand-lt);color:var(--brand);border-radius:20px;padding:2px 10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800}

/* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
@media(max-width:768px){.sidebar{display:none}.kpi-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.session-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.msg-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;height:auto}}

/* ── APPRAISAL PANEL ── */
.appraisal-status-bar{padding:14px 20px;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:20px}
.appraisal-status-bar.draft{background:var(--amber-lt);color:var(--amber);border:1px solid rgba(217,119,6,0.2)}
.appraisal-status-bar.submitted{background:var(--sky-lt);color:var(--sky);border:1px solid rgba(2,132,199,0.2)}
.appraisal-status-bar.revision_requested{background:var(--rose-lt);color:var(--rose);border:1px solid rgba(225,29,72,0.2)}
.appraisal-status-bar.approved{background:var(--emerald-lt);color:var(--emerald);border:1px solid rgba(5,150,105,0.2)}
.evidence-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-bottom:24px}
.evidence-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.evidence-card .ev-val{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;color:var(--brand);margin:6px 0}
.evidence-card .ev-label{font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);font-weight:600}
.evidence-card .ev-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:4px}
.appraisal-section{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:16px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.appraisal-section-header{padding:16px 20px;background:var(--surface2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;cursor:pointer}
.appraisal-section-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:800;color:var(--brand)}
.appraisal-section-body{padding:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.criterion-row{padding:16px;background:var(--surface2);border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--border)}
.criterion-label{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:8px}
.criterion-evidence{font-size:12px;color:var(--emerald);background:var(--emerald-lt);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:10px;display:none}
.rating-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rating-label{font-size:12px;color:var(--text2);font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.star-rating{display:flex;gap:4px}
.star-btn{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:22px;padding:2px;transition:transform .1s}
.star-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.2)}
.rating-badge{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:20px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text2)}
.rating-badge.exceptional{background:rgba(16,185,129,0.1);color:#059669;border-color:rgba(5,150,105,0.2)}
.rating-badge.above{background:rgba(108,61,214,0.08);color:var(--brand);border-color:rgba(108,61,214,0.2)}
.rating-badge.meets{background:rgba(2,132,199,0.08);color:var(--sky);border-color:rgba(2,132,199,0.2)}
.rating-badge.below{background:var(--amber-lt);color:var(--amber);border-color:rgba(217,119,6,0.2)}
.rating-badge.unacceptable{background:var(--rose-lt);color:var(--rose);border-color:rgba(225,29,72,0.2)}
.criterion-note{width:100%;margin-top:8px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px;resize:vertical;min-height:52px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--text)}
.criterion-note:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--brand)}
.upload-zone{border:2px dashed var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:28px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;background:var(--surface)}
.upload-zone:hover{border-color:var(--brand);background:var(--brand-lt)}
.upload-zone-icon{font-size:32px;margin-bottom:8px}
.upload-zone-label{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text2)}
.upload-zone-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:4px}
.uploaded-files-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
.uploaded-file-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;background:var(--surface2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px}
.uploaded-file-row .uf-name{flex:1;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text)}
.appraisal-submit-bar{padding:20px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.appraisal-submit-btn{padding:12px 32px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--brand),var(--brand2));border:none;color:#fff;font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(108,61,214,0.3)}
.appraisal-submit-btn:hover{opacity:.9;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.appraisal-submit-btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none}
.domain-header{padding:10px 16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(108,61,214,0.08),rgba(34,211,238,0.04));border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:var(--brand);margin-bottom:8px}
.revision-note-box{padding:14px 18px;background:var(--rose-lt);border:1px solid rgba(225,29,72,0.2);border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;color:var(--rose);margin-bottom:20px}
.final-score-display{text-align:center;padding:32px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(5,150,105,0.06),rgba(16,185,129,0.04));border-radius:14px;border:1px solid rgba(5,150,105,0.15)}
.final-score-val{font-size:56px;font-weight:900;color:var(--emerald);line-height:1}
.final-score-label{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text);margin-top:8px}
.final-score-grade{font-size:14px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:4px}
.appraisal-locked-msg{padding:16px 20px;background:var(--sky-lt);border:1px solid rgba(2,132,199,0.15);border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--sky);text-align:center;margin-top:16px}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="varkBanner" class="vark-banner">📊 اختبار VARK قيد الانتظار — <a href="../eduos-vark/" style="color:var(--amber);text-decoration:underline">أكمله الآن / Complete Now</a></div>

<div class="app-shell">

<!-- ══ SIDEBAR ══ -->
<aside class="sidebar">
  <div class="sidebar-brand">
    <div class="brand-logo">🎓</div>
    <div class="brand-name">بوابة الجود الذكية</div>
    <div class="brand-sub">Teacher OS · EduOS</div>
  </div>

  <nav class="sidebar-nav">
    <button id="nav-today" class="snav active" onclick="switchPanel('today')">
      <span class="snav-icon">📅</span>
      <span class="snav-text">
        <span class="snav-label">اليوم</span>
        <span class="snav-sub">Today</span>
      </span>
    </button>
    <button id="nav-classes" class="snav" onclick="switchPanel('classes')">
      <span class="snav-icon">👥</span>
      <span class="snav-text">
        <span class="snav-label">فصولي</span>
        <span class="snav-sub">My Classes</span>
      </span>
    </button>
    <button id="nav-grades" class="snav" onclick="switchPanel('grades')">
      <span class="snav-icon">📊</span>
      <span class="snav-text">
        <span class="snav-label">الدرجات</span>
        <span class="snav-sub">Grades</span>
      </span>
    </button>
    <button id="nav-session" class="snav" onclick="switchPanel('session')">
      <span class="snav-icon">🎯</span>
      <span class="snav-text">
        <span class="snav-label">الحصة الحية</span>
        <span class="snav-sub">Live Session</span>
      </span>
    </button>
    <button id="nav-planning" class="snav" onclick="switchPanel('planning')">
      <span class="snav-icon">📝</span>
      <span class="snav-text">
        <span class="snav-label">التخطيط</span>
        <span class="snav-sub">Planning</span>
      </span>
    </button>
    <button id="nav-timetable" class="snav" onclick="switchPanel('timetable')">
      <span class="snav-icon">📅</span>
      <span class="snav-text">
        <span class="snav-label">جداولي</span>
        <span class="snav-sub">My Timetable</span>
      </span>
    </button>
    <button id="nav-comms" class="snav" onclick="switchPanel('comms')">
      <span class="snav-icon">💬</span>
      <span class="snav-text">
        <span class="snav-label">التواصل</span>
        <span class="snav-sub">Communication</span>
      </span>
      <span class="snav-badge" id="msgUnreadBadge">0</span>
    </button>
    <button id="nav-appraisal" class="snav" onclick="switchPanel('appraisal')">
      <span class="snav-icon">⭐</span>
      <span class="snav-text">
        <span class="snav-label">تقييمي</span>
        <span class="snav-sub">My Appraisal</span>
      </span>
      <span class="snav-badge" id="appraisalBadge" style="display:none">!</span>
    </button>
    <button id="nav-pdp" class="snav" onclick="switchPanel('pdp')">
      <span class="snav-icon">📋</span>
      <span class="snav-text">
        <span class="snav-label">خطتي</span>
        <span class="snav-sub">My PDP</span>
      </span>
    </button>
  </nav>

  <div class="sidebar-footer">
    <button class="logout-btn" onclick="doLogout()">🚪 خروج / Logout</button>
  </div>
</aside>

<!-- ══ MAIN ══ -->
<div class="main-area">

  <!-- TOP BAR -->
  <div class="top-bar">
    <div class="top-bar-right">
      <div class="user-chip" onclick="goProfile()">
        <div class="user-avatar" id="userAvatar">م</div>
        <div>
          <div class="user-name" id="userName">جارٍ التحميل…</div>
          <div class="user-role">معلم/ة</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button class="notif-btn" onclick="openNotif()" title="الإشعارات / Notifications">
        🔔<span class="notif-dot" id="notifDot"></span>
      </button>
    </div>
    <div class="top-bar-left">
      <div class="context-pill"><span class="dot"></span><span id="pillText">الأسبوع — · الفصل —</span></div>
      <span id="todayDate" style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);font-weight:600"></span>
      <button class="lang-toggle" data-lang-toggle="1" onclick="window.EduLang && window.EduLang.toggle()" style="font-family:'Tajawal',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:20px;border:1.5px solid #6C3DD6;background:transparent;color:#6C3DD6;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap">🌐 EN / عربي</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- PANELS -->
  <div class="panels-area">

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════ TODAY ══════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="tab-panel active" id="panel-today">

      <!-- Brain bar -->
      <div class="brain-bar" id="brainBar">
        <div class="brain-icon">🧠</div>
        <div style="flex:1">
          <div class="brain-title" id="brainTitle">اقتراح من الذكاء / AI Suggestion</div>
          <div class="brain-msg" id="brainMsg"></div>
        </div>
        <span class="brain-badge" id="brainBadge">B</span>
        <button class="brain-action" id="brainActionBtn">عرض التفاصيل / View</button>
      </div>

      <!-- Greeting -->
      <div class="greeting-card">
        <div class="greeting-text">
          <h2 id="greetMsg">مرحباً 👋</h2>
          <p id="greetSub">جارٍ تحميل بيانات اليوم…</p>
        </div>
        <div class="greeting-meta">
          <div class="meta-pill">
            <div class="val" id="weekNum">—</div>
            <div class="lbl">الأسبوع / Week</div>
          </div>
          <div class="meta-pill">
            <div class="val" id="termLabel">—</div>
            <div class="lbl">الفصل / Term</div>
          </div>
          <div class="meta-pill">
            <div class="val" id="weekLabel">—</div>
            <div class="lbl">الأسبوع / Week</div>
          </div>
          <div class="meta-pill">
            <div class="val" id="countdownVal">——</div>
            <div class="lbl" id="countdownLbl">الوقت / Time</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- KPIs -->
      <div class="kpi-row">
        <div class="kpi-card">
          <div class="kpi-icon">👥</div>
          <div>
            <div class="kpi-val" id="kpiStudents">—</div>
            <div class="kpi-label">طلابي / My Students</div>
            <div class="kpi-delta" id="kpiStudentsDelta">طالب/ة</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card">
          <div class="kpi-icon">✅</div>
          <div>
            <div class="kpi-val" id="kpiAttend">—</div>
            <div class="kpi-label">الحضور اليوم / Attendance</div>
            <div class="kpi-delta" id="kpiAttendDelta">—</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="kpi-card">
          <div class="kpi-icon">🎟️</div>
          <div>
            <div class="kpi-val" id="kpiPending">0</div>
            <div class="kpi-label">بطاقات الخروج / Exit Tickets</div>
            <div class="kpi-delta" id="kpiPendingDelta">مفتوحة / Open</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="studentAlerts"></div>

      <!-- View toggle: اليوم / الأسبوع -->
      <div class="schedule-section">
        <div class="schedule-header">
          <div class="schedule-title">🗓️ جدولي / My Schedule <span class="sec-title" style="display:inline;font-size:14px;border:none;padding:0;margin:0"><span class="badge" id="schedBadge">—</span></span></div>
          <div class="view-toggle">
            <button class="vtb active" id="vtb-day" onclick="showTodayView('day')">اليوم / Today</button>
            <button class="vtb" id="vtb-week" onclick="showTodayView('week')">الأسبوع / Week</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Day view -->
        <div class="today-inner active" id="view-day">
          <div id="schedList"><div class="empty"><div class="icon">📅</div><p>جارٍ التحميل… / Loading…</p></div></div>
        </div>

        <!-- Week view -->
        <div class="today-inner" id="view-week" style="overflow-x:auto;padding:0">
          <div id="weekGridContainer" style="min-width:600px"><div class="empty"><div class="icon">🗓️</div><p>اضغط "الأسبوع" لتحميل الجدول / Click Week to load</p></div></div>
          <div style="padding:12px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)">
            <span id="wkWeekLabel" style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);font-weight:600"></span>
             · 
            <span id="wkTermLabel" style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);font-weight:600"></span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Period NOW card (hidden until JS shows it) -->
      <div id="periodNowCard" style="display:none;margin-top:16px" class="period-now-card">
        <div>
          <div class="period-now-title">● <span id="periodNowSubject">—</span></div>
          <div class="period-now-sub"><span id="periodNowClass">—</span> · الحصة <span id="periodNow">—</span></div>
        </div>
        <div style="text-align:center">
          <div class="period-now-timer" id="periodNowTimer">—</div>
          <div class="period-now-timer-lbl">دقيقة متبقية / mins remaining</div>
        </div>
        <button class="btn-start-session" onclick="window.location.href='../eduos-class-session/'">ابدأ الحصة الآن ← / Start Now</button>
      </div>

    </div>
    <!-- end panel-today -->

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════ CLASSES ══════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-students">
      <p class="sec-title">👥 فصولي / My Classes <span class="badge" id="classBadge"></span></p>
      <div class="table-wrapper">
        <div class="table-toolbar">
          <input type="text" class="search-input" id="studentSearch" placeholder="بحث عن طالب/ة / Search student…" oninput="filterStudents()"/>
          <select class="filter-select" id="classFilter" onchange="loadStudents()">
            <option value="">كل الفصول / All Classes</option>
          </select>
          <button class="btn-sm btn-primary" onclick="window.location.href='../eduos-attendance/'">📋 سجّل حضور / Attendance</button>
        </div>
        <div style="overflow-x:auto">
          <table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>#</th><th>الاسم / Name</th><th>الفصل / Class</th>
                <th>الحضور% / Att%</th><th>المتوسط / Avg</th>
                <th>الاجتهاد / Effort</th><th>SB1</th><th>النجوم / Stars</th>
                <th>المستوى / Level</th><th>إجراء / Action</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody id="studentsBody">
              <tr><td colspan="10" style="text-align:center;padding:32px;color:var(--text3)">جارٍ التحميل… / Loading…</td></tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════ GRADES ══════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-grades">
      <p class="sec-title">📊 الدرجات / Grades</p>
      <div class="table-wrapper">
        <div class="table-toolbar">
          <select class="filter-select" id="gradeClassFilter" onchange="loadGrades()">
            <option value="">كل الفصول / All Classes</option>
          </select>
          <select class="filter-select" id="gradeSubjectFilter" onchange="loadGrades()">
            <option value="">كل المواد / All Subjects</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div style="overflow-x:auto">
          <table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>الطالب/ة / Student</th><th>الفصل / Class</th>
                <th>النوع / Type</th><th>الدرجة / Score</th>
                <th>النسبة% / Pct</th><th>المستوى / Level</th>
                <th>ورقة / Notes</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody id="gradesBody">
              <tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center;padding:32px;color:var(--text3)">اختر فصلاً / Select a class</td></tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════ SESSION ══════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-session">
      <p class="sec-title">🎯 الحصة الحية / Live Session</p>
      <div class="session-grid">
        <div class="session-card">
          <div class="session-card-title">🚀 ابدأ حصة / Start Session</div>
          <p style="font-size:15px;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:20px;line-height:1.7">ابدأ حصة رقمية تفاعلية مع طلابك — يُشغَّل النظام عبر الشاشة الذكية مباشرةً.</p>
          <button class="btn-brand" style="width:100%" onclick="window.location.href='../eduos-class-session/'">ابدأ الحصة الآن ← / Start Now</button>
        </div>
        <div class="session-card">
          <div class="session-card-title">🎟️ بطاقات الخروج / Exit Tickets</div>
          <p style="font-size:15px;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:20px;line-height:1.7">عرض ردود الطلاب على بطاقات الخروج لقياس الفهم الفوري.</p>
          <button class="btn-brand" style="width:100%;background:var(--emerald)" onclick="window.location.href='../eduos-exit-ticket/'">عرض البطاقات / View Tickets</button>
        </div>
        <div class="session-card">
          <div class="session-card-title">⭐ نظام التعزيز / Reinforcement</div>
          <p style="font-size:15px;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:20px;line-height:1.7">امنح النجوم وتتبع تقدم الطلاب السلوكي والأكاديمي.</p>
          <button class="btn-brand" style="width:100%;background:var(--amber)" onclick="window.location.href='../eduos-reinforcement/'">إدارة التعزيز / Manage Stars</button>
        </div>
        <div class="session-card">
          <div class="session-card-title">📱 واجب رقمي / Digital HW</div>
          <p style="font-size:15px;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:20px;line-height:1.7">أنشئ واجباً رقمياً وتتبع التسليم والدرجات فورياً.</p>
          <button class="btn-brand" style="width:100%;background:var(--sky)" onclick="window.location.href='../eduos-assignments/'">إنشاء واجب / Create HW</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════ PLANNING ══════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-planning">
      <p class="sec-title">📝 التخطيط / Planning</p>
      <div class="sub-nav">
        <button class="sub-nav-btn active" id="plan-btn-track" onclick="switchPlanTab('track')">📆 المسار الأسبوعي / Weekly Track</button>
        <button class="sub-nav-btn" id="plan-btn-meetings" onclick="switchPlanTab('meetings')">🤝 الاجتماعات / Meetings</button>
        <button class="sub-nav-btn" id="plan-btn-pd" onclick="switchPlanTab('pd')">📈 التطوير المهني / PD</button>
      </div>

      <!-- TRACK -->
      <div class="sub-panel active" id="plan-panel-track">
        <div class="track-nav">
          <button class="track-nav-btn" onclick="changeTrackWeek(-1)">◀ السابق / Prev</button>
          <div class="track-nav-label" id="trackWeekLabel">—</div>
          <button class="track-nav-btn" onclick="changeTrackWeek(1)">التالي / Next ▶</button>
          <a href="../eduos-weekly-track/" class="btn-sm btn-ghost">فتح كامل / Full View</a>
        </div>
        <div id="trackWeeksContainer"><div class="empty"><div class="icon">📆</div><p>جارٍ التحميل… / Loading…</p></div></div>
      </div>

      <!-- MEETINGS -->
      <div class="sub-panel" id="plan-panel-meetings">
        <div style="margin-bottom:16px;display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center">
          <select class="filter-select" id="meetingsFilter" onchange="loadMeetings()">
            <option value="all">كل الاجتماعات / All</option>
            <option value="upcoming">القادمة / Upcoming</option>
            <option value="today">اليوم / Today</option>
            <option value="past">المضت / Past</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div id="meetingsTimeline"><div class="empty"><div class="icon">🤝</div><p>جارٍ التحميل… / Loading…</p></div></div>
      </div>

      <!-- PD -->
      <div class="sub-panel" id="plan-panel-pd">
        <div class="pd-stats">
          <div class="pd-stat"><div class="val" id="pdUpcoming">—</div><div class="lbl">قادمة / Upcoming</div></div>
          <div class="pd-stat"><div class="val" id="pdCompleted">—</div><div class="lbl">مكتملة / Completed</div></div>
          <div class="pd-stat"><div class="val" id="pdHours">—</div><div class="lbl">ساعات / Hours</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="pd-events" id="pdEventsList"><div class="empty"><div class="icon">📈</div><p>جارٍ التحميل… / Loading…</p></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════ TIMETABLE ══════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-timetable">
      <p class="sec-title">📅 جداولي الأسبوعي / My Weekly Timetable</p>
      <div id="teacherTimetableWrap" style="overflow-x:auto"></div>
      <div style="margin-top:20px;display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap">
        <a href="../eduos-timetable/" target="_blank" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 20px;background:var(--brand);color:#fff;border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;font-size:14px">🗓 جدول المدرسة الكامل | Full School Timetable</a>
        <a href="../eduos-timetable-pdf/" target="_blank" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 20px;background:var(--surface2);color:var(--brand);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;font-size:14px">🖨 طباعة | Print</a>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ══════════════════════════════ COMMS ══════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-comms">
      <p class="sec-title">💬 التواصل / Communication</p>
      <div class="sub-nav">
        <button class="sub-nav-btn active" id="comm-btn-messages" onclick="switchCommTab('messages')">💬 الرسائل / Messages</button>
        <button class="sub-nav-btn" id="comm-btn-ai" onclick="switchCommTab('ai')">🤖 الذكاء / AI <span id="aiBadge" style="background:var(--rose);color:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:1px 7px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;margin-right:4px">0</span></button>
        <button class="sub-nav-btn" id="comm-btn-reports" onclick="switchCommTab('reports')">📋 التقارير / Reports</button>
      </div>

      <!-- MESSAGES -->
      <div class="sub-panel active" id="comm-panel-messages">
        <div class="msg-layout">
          <div class="msg-list">
            <input type="text" class="msg-search" id="msgSearch" placeholder="بحث / Search…" oninput="filterMessages()"/>
            <div id="msgList"><div class="empty"><div class="icon">💬</div><p>لا رسائل / No messages</p></div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="msg-chat">
            <div class="msg-chat-header" id="msgChatHeader">اختر محادثة / Select a conversation</div>
            <div class="msg-chat-body" id="msgChatBody"></div>
            <div class="msg-chat-footer">
              <input type="text" class="msg-input" id="msgInput" placeholder="اكتب رسالة / Type a message…" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')sendMessage()"/>
              <button class="btn-brand" onclick="sendMessage()">إرسال / Send</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- AI -->
      <div class="sub-panel" id="comm-panel-ai">
        <div class="suggestion-card" style="background:var(--brand-lt);border-color:rgba(108,61,214,0.2);margin-bottom:20px">
          <div class="suggestion-icon">🤖</div>
          <div class="suggestion-body">
            <div class="suggestion-title">مساعد الذكاء الاصطناعي / AI Assistant</div>
            <div class="suggestion-text">اطرح أي سؤال عن الطلاب أو المنهج أو التقارير — الذكاء يجيبك بناءً على بيانات فصلك الفعلية.</div>
          </div>
        </div>

// ── PERIOD TIMING ──
function getPeriodTime(period, className) {
  const isKG = (className||'').toUpperCase().includes('KG');
  const gradeNum = parseInt((className||'').replace(/[^0-9]/g,'')) || 0;
  const isLower = isKG || gradeNum <= 4;
  const startH = 7, startM = 15, dur = isLower ? 40 : 45;
  let totalMin = startH * 60 + startM;
  for (let i = 1; i < period; i++) {
    totalMin += dur;
    if ([2,4].includes(i)) totalMin += 10;
  }
  const fmt = m => String(Math.floor(m/60)) + ':' + String(m%60).padStart(2,'0');
  return { start: fmt(totalMin), end: fmt(totalMin+dur), startMin: totalMin, endMin: totalMin+dur };
}

// ── INIT ──

});

// ── DATETIME ──
function setupDateTime() {
  const now = new Date();
  const days = ['الأحد','الاثنين','الثلاثاء','الأربعاء','الخميس','الجمعة','السبت'];
  const months = ['يناير','فبراير','مارس','أبريل','مايو','يونيو','يوليو','أغسطس','سبتمبر','أكتوبر','نوفمبر','ديسمبر'];
  document.getElementById('todayDate').textContent = days[now.getDay()] + ' ' + now.getDate() + ' ' + months[now.getMonth()];
  const h = now.getHours();
  const greet = h < 12 ? 'صباح النور ☀️ / Good Morning' : h < 17 ? 'مساء الخير 🌤️ / Good Afternoon' : 'مساء النور 🌙 / Good Evening';
  document.getElementById('greetMsg').textContent = greet;
}

function setupWeekHeader() {
  if (window.getPlatformWeek) {
    const w = window.getPlatformWeek();
    const wn = w.week || '—'; const tn = w.term || '—';
    document.getElementById('weekNum').textContent = wn;
    document.getElementById('weekLabel').textContent = 'أسبوع ' + wn;
    document.getElementById('termLabel').textContent = 'الفصل ' + tn;
    const wkw = document.getElementById('wkWeekLabel'); if(wkw) wkw.textContent = 'أسبوع ' + wn;
    const wkt = document.getElementById('wkTermLabel'); if(wkt) wkt.textContent = 'الفصل ' + tn;
    document.getElementById('pillText').textContent = 'الأسبوع ' + wn + ' · الفصل ' + tn;
  } else { setTimeout(setupWeekHeader, 800); }
}

// ── TODAY VIEW TOGGLE ──
function showTodayView(view) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.today-inner').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.vtb').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('view-' + view).classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('vtb-' + view).classList.add('active');
  if (view === 'week') loadFullWeekSchedule();
}

// ── COUNTDOWN ──
function startCountdown() {
  function tick() {
    const now = new Date();
    const nowMin = now.getHours()*60 + now.getMinutes();
    const nowSec = now.getSeconds();
    const valEl = document.getElementById('countdownVal');
    const lblEl = document.getElementById('countdownLbl');
    if (!valEl) return;
    let found = null;
    for (const s of todayScheduleData) {
      const {startMin, endMin} = getPeriodTime(s.period || 1, s.class_name);
      if (nowMin >= startMin && nowMin < endMin) {
        found = { rem: (endMin - nowMin)*60 - nowSec, label: 'حتى انتهاء الحصة ' + (s.period||''), subject: s.subject||'—', cls: s.class_name||'', period: s.period||'' };
        // Show period-now card
        const card = document.getElementById('periodNowCard');
        if (card) { card.style.display = 'flex'; }
        document.getElementById('periodNowSubject').textContent = s.subject || '—';
        document.getElementById('periodNowClass').textContent = s.class_name || '—';
        document.getElementById('periodNow').textContent = s.period || '—';
        break;
      }
      if (nowMin < startMin) {
        found = { rem: (startMin - nowMin)*60 - nowSec, label: 'حتى بداية الحصة ' + (s.period||'') };
        break;
      }
    }
    if (found && found.rem > 0) {
      const m = Math.floor(found.rem / 60);
      const sc = found.rem % 60;
      const timeStr = m + ':' + String(sc).padStart(2,'0');
      valEl.textContent = timeStr;
      lblEl.textContent = found.label;
      const timerEl = document.getElementById('periodNowTimer');

    } else {

}

// ── FULL WEEK SCHEDULE ──
async function loadFullWeekSchedule() {
  if (!sb || !teacherNumericId) {
    document.getElementById('weekGridContainer').innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><div class="icon">📅</div><p>لا جدول مرتبط / No schedule linked</p></div>';
    return;
  }
  try {
    const { data } = await sb.from('schedules').select('*').eq('is_active', true).eq('teacher_id', teacherNumericId).order('period');
    if (!data || !data.length) {
      document.getElementById('weekGridContainer').innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><div class="icon">📅</div><p>لا بيانات جدول / No schedule data</p></div>';
      return;
    }
    const dayOrder = ['الاثنين','الثلاثاء','الأربعاء','الخميس','الجمعة'];
    const dayEn = ['Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri'];
    const todayAr = ['الأحد','الاثنين','الثلاثاء','الأربعاء','الخميس','الجمعة','السبت'][new Date().getDay()];
    const map = {}; dayOrder.forEach(d => { map[d] = {}; });
    data.forEach(s => { if (map[s.day] && s.period) map[s.day][s.period] = s; });
    const maxPeriod = Math.max(...data.map(s => s.period || 1), 8);
    const now = new Date(); const nowMin = now.getHours()*60 + now.getMinutes();
    let html = '<div class="week-grid">';
    html += '<div class="wg-header">الحصة</div>';
    dayOrder.forEach((d, i) => {
      const isToday = d === todayAr;
      html += '<div class="wg-header" style="' + (isToday?'background:rgba(108,61,214,0.1);color:var(--brand)':'') + '">' + d + '<br><span style="font-size:10px;opacity:.7">' + dayEn[i] + '</span></div>';
    });
    for (let p = 1; p <= maxPeriod; p++) {
      const firstSched = data.find(s => s.period === p);
      const timing = getPeriodTime(p, firstSched ? firstSched.class_name : '');
      html += '<div class="wg-period-label"><strong>' + p + '</strong><br><span style="font-size:10px">' + timing.start + '</span></div>';
      dayOrder.forEach((d) => {
        const s = map[d] && map[d][p];
        const isToday = d === todayAr;
        const {startMin, endMin} = getPeriodTime(p, s ? s.class_name : '');
        const isCurrent = isToday && nowMin >= startMin && nowMin < endMin;
        html += '<div class="wg-cell ' + (isToday?'today-col':'') + ' ' + (isCurrent?'current-period':'') + '">'
          + (s ? '<div class="wg-subject">' + (s.subject||'—') + '</div><div class="wg-class">' + (s.class_name||'') + '</div>'
                    + (isCurrent ? '<div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--emerald);font-weight:800;margin-top:2px">● جارية</div>' : '')
               : '<div class="wg-empty">—</div>')
          + '</div>';
      });
    }
    html += '</div>';
    document.getElementById('weekGridContainer').innerHTML = html;
  } catch(e) {
    document.getElementById('weekGridContainer').innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><div class="icon">⚠️</div><p>خطأ / Error</p></div>';
  }
}

  const body = document.getElementById('studentsBody');
  try {

      body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="10" style="text-align:center;padding:32px;color:var(--text3)">لا فصول مرتبطة / No classes linked</td></tr>'; return;
    }
    let q = sb.from('students').select('id,name,name_en,grade,class_name,student_number').in('class_name', teacherClasses);
    if (classFilter) q = q.eq('class_name', classFilter);
    const { data } = await q.order('class_name').order('name');
    allStudents = data || [];
    const stuIds = allStudents.map(s => s.id);
    const { data: grades } = stuIds.length ? await sb.from('student_grades').select('student_id,score,max_score').in('student_id', stuIds) : { data: [] };
    const avgMap = {};
    if (grades) {
      const grouped = {};
      grades.forEach(g => { if(!grouped[g.student_id]) grouped[g.student_id]=[]; if(g.max_score) grouped[g.student_id].push(g.score/g.max_score*100); });
      Object.entries(grouped).forEach(([id,scores]) => { avgMap[id] = Math.round(scores.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/scores.length); });
    }
    renderStudentsTable(allStudents, avgMap, new Set());
    const classes = [...new Set(allStudents.map(s=>s.class_name).filter(Boolean))].sort();
    const cf = document.getElementById('classFilter');
    if (cf && cf.options.length === 1) classes.forEach(c => { const o = document.createElement('option'); o.value=c; o.textContent=c; cf.appendChild(o); });
    const atRisk = allStudents.filter(s => (avgMap[s.id]||100) < 50);
    if (atRisk.length) document.getElementById('studentAlerts').innerHTML = '<div class="alert-banner danger">⚠️ ' + atRisk.length + ' طالب/ة يحتاج/ون متابعة [المستوى B]</div>';
  } catch(e) { console.warn('students:', e); }
}

function renderStudentsTable(students, avgMap, flagSet) {
  const body = document.getElementById('studentsBody');
  if (!students.length) { body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="10" style="text-align:center;padding:32px;color:var(--text3)">لا طلاب / No students</td></tr>'; return; }
  const effort = n => 18 + (parseInt(n,36) % 3);
  body.innerHTML = students.map((s,i) => {
    const avg = avgMap[s.id] || null;
    const att = s.attendance_pct || null;
    const lvl = avg === null ? '—' : avg >= 90 ? 'A' : avg >= 75 ? 'B' : avg >= 60 ? 'C' : 'D';
    const e = effort(s.id || i);
    const stars = s.reinforcement_stars || 0;
    const sb1 = avg ? Math.min(100, Math.round(avg*0.4 + (att||80)*0.3 + e*3)) : null;
    return '<tr><td>' + (i+1) + '</td>'
      + '<td style="font-weight:700">' + ((window.EduLang?.getLang()==='en'&&s.name_en)?s.name_en:(s.name||'—')) + '</td>'
      + '<td>' + (s.class_name||'—') + '</td>'
      + '<td>' + (att!==null?att+'%':'—') + '</td>'
      + '<td>' + (avg!==null?avg+'%':'—') + '</td>'
      + '<td style="font-size:12px">' + '★'.repeat(Math.min(e,5)) + '</td>'
      + '<td>' + (sb1!==null?'<div class="sb1-bar"><div class="sb1-fill" style="width:'+sb1+'%"></div></div> '+sb1:'—') + '</td>'
      + '<td>⭐ ' + stars + '</td>'
      + '<td>' + (flagSet.has(s.id)?'<span class="flag-chip">⚠️</span>':'<span class="grade-chip grade-'+(lvl||'x').toLowerCase()+'">'+lvl+'</span>') + '</td>'
      + '<td><button class="btn-sm btn-ghost" onclick="viewStudent(\'' + s.id + '\')">عرض / View</button></td></tr>';
  }).join('');
}

async function loadMeetings() {
  if (!sb) return;

  const container = document.getElementById('meetingsTimeline');
  const today = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
  try {
    let q = sb.from('staff_meetings').select('*').order('meeting_date',{ascending:false}).limit(30);

    let meetings = data;
    if (filter === 'past') meetings = meetings.filter(m => m.meeting_date < today);
    else if (filter === 'today') meetings = meetings.filter(m => m.meeting_date === today);
    else if (filter === 'upcoming') meetings = meetings.filter(m => m.meeting_date > today);

      const dotClass = isPast?'past':isToday?'today':'upcoming';
      const badgeClass = isPast?'t-past':isToday?'t-today':'t-upcoming';
      const badgeText = isPast?'مضى / Past':isToday?'اليوم / Today':'قادم / Upcoming';
      const icon = isPast?'✓':isToday?'●':'◆';
      return '<div class="timeline-item"><div class="timeline-dot '+dotClass+'">'+icon+'</div>'
        + '<div class="timeline-body '+(isToday?'today':'')+'"><div class="timeline-title">'+(m.title||m.meeting_title||'اجتماع')+'</div>'
        + '<div class="timeline-meta">📅 '+(m.meeting_date||'—')+' · '+(m.meeting_time||'')+' · '+(m.location||'')+'</div>'

        + '<span class="timeline-badge '+badgeClass+'">'+badgeText+'</span></div></div>';
    }).join('') + '</div>';

}

async function loadMessages() {

      const partnerRole = m.sender_id === teacherId ? (m.recipient_role||'') : (m.sender_role||'parent');
      if (!convMap[partnerId]) convMap[partnerId] = { id:partnerId, name:partnerName, role:partnerRole, messages:[], unread:0 };
      convMap[partnerId].messages.push(m);

    });

    const roleIcon = r => r==='parent'?'👨‍👩‍👧':r==='teacher'?'👨‍🏫':'👤';
    listEl.innerHTML = convs.map(c => {
      const lastMsg = c.messages[0];
      const preview = (lastMsg.body||lastMsg.content||'').substring(0,40);
      return '<div class="msg-list-item" id="conv-'+c.id+'" onclick="openConversation(\''+c.id+'\',\''+c.name.replace(/'/g,"\\'")+'\')"><span class="msg-time">'+formatMsgTime(lastMsg.created_at)+'</span><div class="msg-sender">'+roleIcon(c.role)+' '+c.name+(c.unread?'<span class="msg-unread-dot"></span>':'')+'</div><div class="msg-preview">'+preview+'</div></div>';
    }).join('');

function openConversation(partnerId, partnerName) {

// ── WEEKLY TRACK ──
async function loadWeeklyTrack() {
  if (!sb || !teacherId) return;
  const container = document.getElementById('trackWeeksContainer');
  try {
    const now = new Date();
    const weeks = [-1,0,1].map(i => {
      const d = new Date(now); d.setDate(d.getDate() + (i+trackWeekOffset)*7);
      const day = d.getDay(); const diff = day===0?-6:1-day;
      const mon = new Date(d); mon.setDate(d.getDate()+diff);
      return mon.toISOString().split('T')[0];
    });
    document.getElementById('trackWeekLabel').textContent = weeks[0] + ' → ' + weeks[2];
    const { data } = await sb.from('weekly_track').select('*,weekly_track_items(*),weekly_track_approvals(*)').eq('staff_id',teacherId).in('week_start_date',weeks);
    const trackMap = {};
    (data||[]).forEach(w => { trackMap[w.week_start_date] = w; });
    container.innerHTML = weeks.map((wStart, wi) => {
      const w = trackMap[wStart];
      const label = wi===0?'الأسبوع السابق / Prev':wi===1?'الأسبوع الحالي / Current':'الأسبوع القادم / Next';
      const isCurrent = wi===1;
      const isApproved = w?.all_approved; const isLocked = w?.is_locked;
      const statusClass = isLocked?'ts-locked':isApproved?'ts-approved':isCurrent?'ts-pending':'ts-draft';
      const statusText = isLocked?'🔒 مغلق':isApproved?'✅ معتمد':isCurrent?'⏳ انتظار':'📝 مسودة';
      const items = w ? (w.weekly_track_items||[]) : [];
      return '<div class="track-card '+(isApproved?'approved':'')+' '+(isLocked?'locked':'')+'" style="'+(isCurrent?'border:2px solid var(--brand)':'')+'">'
        + '<div class="track-card-header"><div class="track-week-title">'+(isCurrent?'⭐ ':'')+label+' <span style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);font-weight:500">'+wStart+'</span></div>'
        + '<span class="track-status-badge '+statusClass+'">'+statusText+'</span></div>'
        + (items.length ? items.map((item,ii) => '<div class="track-item-row"><div class="track-item-num">'+(ii+1)+'</div><div class="track-item-text '+(item.is_strikethrough?'track-item-done':'')+'">'+( item.content||'—')+'</div>'+(item.subject?'<span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);padding:2px 6px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border)">'+item.subject+'</span>':'')+'</div>').join('')
          : '<div style="font-size:14px;color:var(--text3);padding:12px;text-align:center">لا مواضيع مدخلة / No topics entered</div>')
        + (isCurrent&&!isLocked&&!isApproved?'<div style="margin-top:14px;text-align:left"><button class="track-approve-btn" onclick="approveTrackWeek(\''+(w?.id||'')+'\',\''+wStart+'\')">✅ اعتماد الأسبوع / Approve</button></div>':'')
        + '</div>';
    }).join('');
  } catch(e) { container.innerHTML = '<div class="empty"><div class="icon">📆</div><p>خطأ / Error — <a href="../eduos-weekly-track/" style="color:var(--brand)">افتح النسخة الكاملة</a></p></div>'; }
}

async function approveTrackWeek(trackId, weekStart) {
  if (!sb || !teacherId) return;

    if (newTrack) await sb.from('weekly_track_approvals').insert({track_id:newTrack.id,approver_id:teacherId,approved_at:new Date().toISOString(),role:'teacher'});

}

let currentAppraisal = null;
let appraisalLocked = false;
const APPRAISAL_YEAR = '2025-2026';

const ALL_CRITERIA = [
  'g1','g2','g3','g4','g5','g6',
  'c1_1','c1_2','c1_3',
  'c2_1','c2_2','c2_3','c2_4','c2_5',
  'c3_1','c3_2','c3_3',
  'c4_1','c4_2'
];

function getRatingLabel(v) {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return 'لم يُقيَّم';
  if (v >= 4.5) return 'استثنائي';
  if (v >= 3.5) return 'يفوق التوقعات';
  if (v >= 2.5) return 'يلبي التوقعات';
  if (v >= 1.5) return 'دون التوقعات';
  if (v >= 0) return 'غير مقبول';
  return 'لم يُقيَّم';
}

function getRatingClass(v) {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return '';
  if (v >= 4.5) return 'exceptional';
  if (v >= 3.5) return 'above';
  if (v >= 2.5) return 'meets';
  if (v >= 1.5) return 'below';
  return 'unacceptable';
}

function buildStars(criterionId, currentVal, locked) {
  var container = document.getElementById('stars-' + criterionId);
  if (!container) return;
  container.innerHTML = '';
  var steps = [0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 4.5, 5];
  steps.forEach(function(v) {
    var btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.className = 'star-btn';
    btn.setAttribute('data-val', v);
    btn.setAttribute('data-cid', criterionId);
    btn.disabled = locked;
    var filled = currentVal !== null && currentVal !== undefined && v <= currentVal;
    btn.textContent = filled ? '★' : '☆';
    btn.style.color = filled ? '#F59E0B' : '#CBD5E1';
    if (!locked) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var val = parseFloat(this.getAttribute('data-val'));
        var cid = this.getAttribute('data-cid');
        setRating(cid, val);
      });
    }
    container.appendChild(btn);
  });
}

function setRating(criterionId, val) {
  if (appraisalLocked) return;
  buildStars(criterionId, val, false);
  var badge = document.getElementById('badge-' + criterionId);
  if (badge) {
    badge.textContent = getRatingLabel(val) + ' (' + val + ')';
    badge.className = 'rating-badge ' + getRatingClass(val);
  }
  autoSaveDraft();
}

function initAllStars(selfScores, locked) {
  ALL_CRITERIA.forEach(function(cid) {
    var val = selfScores && selfScores[cid] !== undefined ? selfScores[cid] : null;
    buildStars(cid, val, locked);
    if (val !== null) {
      var badge = document.getElementById('badge-' + cid);
      if (badge) {
        badge.textContent = getRatingLabel(val) + ' (' + val + ')';
        badge.className = 'rating-badge ' + getRatingClass(val);
      }
    }
    if (selfScores && selfScores['note_' + cid]) {
      var noteEl = document.getElementById('note-' + cid);
      if (noteEl) noteEl.value = selfScores['note_' + cid];
    }
    if (locked) {
      var noteEl = document.getElementById('note-' + cid);
      if (noteEl) noteEl.disabled = true;
    }
  });
}

function collectSelfScores() {
  var scores = {};
  ALL_CRITERIA.forEach(function(cid) {
    var container = document.getElementById('stars-' + cid);
    if (!container) return;
    var filled = container.querySelectorAll('[data-val]');
    var maxFilled = null;
    filled.forEach(function(btn) {
      if (btn.textContent === '★') maxFilled = parseFloat(btn.getAttribute('data-val'));
    });
    if (maxFilled !== null) scores[cid] = maxFilled;
    var noteEl = document.getElementById('note-' + cid);
    if (noteEl && noteEl.value.trim()) scores['note_' + cid] = noteEl.value.trim();
  });
  return scores;
}
